ammonia.reason: NH3 from amino-acid deamination by surface Brevibacterium/coryneforms in herbal-brine smear, moderate in whole cheese.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol, indole and 3-methylbutanoic acid from tyrosine/tryptophan/leucine catabolism by smear flora.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic peptides from chymosin/plasmin proteolysis largely hydrolyzed by Lactobacillus peptidases.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti, no blue-mold methyl-ketone and 1-octen-3-ol dominated pathway.

browning.reason: Maillard between free amino acids and residual galactose/lactate on heating of aged cooked curd.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl from citrate metabolism by Lactococcus diacetylactis largely reduced to acetoin/butanediol during aging.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: C4-C6 free fatty acids plus 3-methylbutanoic acid from lipolysis and leucine transamination by smear bacteria.

creaminess.reason: 33.5% fat, ~53% FDM with proteolyzed para-casein gives smooth but firm, not spreadable mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Cooked pressed elastic para-casein network with smear surface proteolysis, sliceable not crumbly.

firmness.reason: Cooked pressed curd at 36.5% moisture with calcium-phosphate crosslinks gives firm elastic paste.

floral_honey.reason: 2-phenylethanol and phenylacetaldehyde from phenylalanine catabolism by yeasts and lactobacilli.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from ethanol plus free fatty-acid esterification by yeasts/smear bacteria.

goaty.reason: Cow milk low in caproic/caprylic acids, no goat-specific 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic acids.

malty_nutty.reason: 2-/3-methylbutanal and 2-methylpropanal from Strecker and Val/Leu/Ile catabolism in cooked aged curd.

melt.reason: pH 6.03 with solubilized colloidal calcium and 1.3-1.6% salt allows good flow and fusion on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one from linoleic-acid oxidation, limited versus bloomy-rind cheeses.

oil_off.reason: Free-fat release on melting from 33.5% fat aged network with partial fat coalescence.

smoky.reason: No smoking step, no guaiacol/syringol from wood pyrolysis.

sour_vinegar.reason: Acetic acid ~42 mmol/kg from heterofermentative LAB/smear metabolism buffered by proteolysis high pH.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water stretching, only limited extensibility of cooked rennet gel.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Methanethiol/dimethyl disulfide from methionine gamma-lyase of Brevibacterium linens in herbal brine.

sweet.reason: Low residual lactose plus sweet amino acids proline/glycine and propionic acid ~24 mmol/kg sweet note.

umami.reason: Glutamate accumulation from rennet/plasmin plus Lactobacillus peptidase proteolysis over ~150 d.
